messages:
emily: Heads-up — we’re targeting SDK v14 rollout tomorrow 09:30 PT. This is a minor-major: new streaming API + small change to error codes. Need smoke owners and rollback ready owners.
raj: I can own smoke checks for hosted API paths (/v1/generate, /v1/chat). Will run smoke script and sanity prompts.
carlos: FYI there’s one backward-incompatible change for custom metadata headers: `x-rw-client-id` is now `x-rw-client` (we added normalization). We can feature-flag it server-side for two weeks.
tina: I’ll own rollback readiness: I’ll prepare an automated rollback plan and a runbook snippet. If canary fails, flip `sdk_v14_enabled=false` in config service.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by @emily at 1965435700; 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m, health checks at each step.
emily: Thanks @raj @tina. @carlos — can we add a deprecation header for one week so clients see a warning?
carlos: Yes — we’ll emit `Warning: X-RW-CLIENT deprecated; use X-RW-CLIENT-ID` for one week and log counts. Also adding a small compatibility shim in the token parsing layer.
oliver: Who’s doing external client comms (changelog + migration guide)? We should post a short note in docs and a Slack announcement in #general.
sasha: I’ll draft the changelog and migration snippet tonight. Example code block for clients: 
```
// old
headers['x-rw-client-id'] = clientId;
// new
headers['x-rw-client'] = clientId;
```
I’ll include feature-flag example: `RW_SDK_V14=1` for devs.
raj: For smoke, I’ll run these checks: 1) basic generation latency < 300ms on p95, 2) streaming chunk sequence preserved, 3) error-code mapping validated. Posting script: `./tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --endpoints /v1/generate,/v1/chat --retries 3`
tina: Rollback checklist: 
- set `sdk_v14_enabled=false`
- validate config propagate in <60s
- restart 3 proxy nodes (if needed)
- monitor 5m for 5xx increase >1%
I’ll keep comms channel open during rollout.
emily: Good. Last Q: any external SDK changes that will require vendor teams to update immediately? We should avoid breaking third-party integrators if possible.
carlos: No blocking changes besides header rename. We’ll keep shim + warning header for a week, then flip.
sasha: Drafts will be in #docs-drafts by EOD. I’ll ping integrations partners list after canary completes.
deploy-bot: Canary stage 10% completed — health checks passed.
raj: First smoke pass looks clean. Latency good, no streaming regressions.
emily: Awesome. If canary stays green at 50% we proceed to full. I’ll update this thread with final go/no-go at 09:55 PT. :thumbsup:
